definitions.explanation: A disease caused by uncontrolled cell division. A serious medical condition.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{癌|がん}で{亡|な}くなった。
examples.english: My father passed away from cancer.

examples.japanese: {早期|そうき}{発見|はっけん}で{癌|がん}を{治|なお}す。
examples.english: To cure cancer through early detection.

examples.japanese: {癌|がん}{検診|けんしん}を{受|う}ける。

notes:
{癌|がん} is the medical term for cancer. Often written in katakana as ガン in everyday contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {癌|がん}になる (to get cancer)
- {癌|がん}を{患|わずら}う (to suffer from cancer)
- {癌|がん}が{見|み}つかる (cancer is found)

TYPES OF CANCER:
- {胃|い}{癌|がん} (stomach cancer)
- {肺|はい}{癌|がん} (lung cancer)
- {乳|にゅう}{癌|がん} (breast cancer)
- {大腸|だいちょう}{癌|がん} (colon cancer)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {癌|がん}{細胞|さいぼう} (cancer cells)
- {癌|がん}{検診|けんしん} (cancer screening)
- {癌|がん}{治療|ちりょう} (cancer treatment)
- {抗|こう}{癌|がん}{剤|ざい} (anti-cancer drug)
